title: Summer chlorophyll vertical profile
query: Using the 2011 CMOMS data and supplied shelf mask, draw one summer (June-August) mean chlorophyll-versus-depth profile. At each supplied fixed depth, first calculate the valid-area-weighted regional mean for each day, then average valid daily means. Use supplied depth levels without vertical extrapolation. Mark the largest sampled mean concentration and its depth, and briefly state whether the profile shows an interior or surface maximum, or whether sampling cannot resolve it. Use the frozen B1 manifest for masks and geometry, keep missing values distinct from zero, and retain the calculation code for checking. Only one figure and one short conclusion are requested.

input_contract.depth: all supplied fixed physical depth levels; do not surface-trim the shared archive
metadata_required: calendar, time bounds, fill values and QC
longitude/latitude, positive-down depth and wet/land masks
input_contract.notes: One shared archive, not six copies. Science fields exist in the supplied avg_info.cdl, but the header does not prove the 2011 files or geometry are available. temp is labelled potential temperature; salt convention must be confirmed. Freeze physical bottom-level indices before applying daily data validity; a missing bottom value is not permission to substitute a shallower value. Use the user's per-year/per-variable fixed-depth layout. Freeze any preprocessing and bottom mapping before evaluation, and give both systems the identical prepared grid.
